theme: The Denial Came First - Volume III
title: Compliance on the Shelf
hook: A prize for governance. An open file.
stamp: The trophy arrived. The answer did not.

scenes.text: November. The agency receives the RGB prize for governance, risk management and compliance.
Same month, same institution: a formal denúncia still unanswered on the substance. Evidence not engaged. Decision-maker still unnamed.
A prize for the system. A silence for the file. Both can be true at the same time. That is the interesting part.
